1. (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node is configured to transmit to a second node at an access attempt percentage, and wherein each of the nodes is configured to provide an __indicia__ of its inter-node interference to __at least one other node__ of the nodes, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on __the indicia provided by at least one other node__.

3. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference comprises an indicia of transmission success between __the other nodes and the second node__.

4. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on the indicia of inter-node interference of the first node __divided by the average indicia of inter-node interference of the plurality of nodes__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast __a dynamic weight associated with the second node to at least one node in communication with the first access point__.

17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and the first node is configured to __monitor communications to determine if it interferes with__ communication between the second node and the second access point.
